about: Conformance vectors of the set_clip timeline command.

vectors.name: a name belongs to the named clip only
a speed change retimes the linked partner too
motion merges; a keyframe channel is replaced as a whole
effects null clears everything but the transition
enabled false disables the clip and its linked partner
null clears a mask and a blend mode
the transition has its own command
a mask on an audio clip
slowing a clip into its neighbour
an adjustment layer takes effects, colour, a fade, a mask, opacity keys and a blend mode
an adjustment layer has no picture of its own to move
an adjustment layer has no clock of its own to retime
an adjustment layer has no sound
